# msl_event (Resource)

Manages an MSL5 **Event** resource (`/api/v1/streams/{stream_id}/events`). Events are time-bounded broadcasts within a stream. There is no update operation — all fields force replacement.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `event_name` (String) Unique name of the event within the stream. Must be non-empty. Used as the path identifier in API calls. Immutable: can only be set during resource creation.
- `stream_id` (String) ID of the stream this event belongs to. Immutable: can only be set during resource creation.

### Optional

- `end_time` (String) RFC3339 end time for the event. Must be after `start_time`. Immutable: can only be set during resource creation.
- `source_event_name` (String) Source event name for past-event clipping. Immutable: can only be set during resource creation.
- `start_time` (String) RFC3339 start time for the event. When omitted, the API assigns a default. Immutable: can only be set during resource creation.
- `subsegment_clipping` (Boolean) Enable sub-segment clipping (`#EXT-X-START:TIME-OFFSET`). Immutable: can only be set during resource creation.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the event is currently active.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of when the event was created.
- `egress_filepaths` (Set of String) Set of multivariant manifest paths that have been ingested for this event.
- `ended` (Boolean) Whether the event has ended.
- `id` (String) The unique event ID assigned by the MSL5 API (`event_id`).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of the last update.



## Import

```bash
terraform import msl_event.live <stream_id>/<event_name>
```
